diffs.diff: pin count: part has 4 (SCL SDA VCC GND), datasheet reading has 5 (SCL SDA VCC GND INT)
diffs.evidence: INT is a pin of the TMG39931 chip, but on this Grove board it is routed only to the single-pad header J1 (Eagle schematic: net INT = U3 INT, R2, J1 pin 1), while the module itself is wired through its 4-pin Grove I2C connector as the Seeed wiki says: 'Connect the Grove - Light&Gesture&Color&Proximity Sensor(TMG39931) to port I2C of Grove-Base Shield', and the Seeed interrupt example polls the status register instead.
